title: Genesis 4:4 — Abel brings the firstborn of his flock
summary: Genesis 4:4 in English: Abel brought an offering from the firstborn of his flock and their fat portions, and the LORD had regard for Abel and his offering. The word "firstborn" is highlighted in red.

text.text: 4 And Abel, he also brought an offering, from the firstborn of his flock and from their fat portions. And the LORD had regard for Abel and his offering;
